items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I played with Rene, yeah. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Kid Rene's brass band.

ctx.x: Did you ever play any parades in any brass bands in those days? I played with Rene, yeah.

Kid Rene. Yeah, Kid Rene. This other T-Boy Rene, a similar name, at that time was he in the Eureka band? When I heard him, he was in the Eureka band. T-Boy. T-Boy, that was quite late though. I just wondered...

items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
